title: Amazon just tripled its order of Nvidia chips over 'surging demand' | TechCrunch
summary: With the 2 million GPU chips Amazon is adding to AWS starting in the third quarter, Nvidia also plans to send an unspecified number of Vera CPUs, “some integrated with Rubin, others standalone,” according to Nvidia CFO Colette Kress.
